  id,

  1,
  '目標達成型の営業リーダー',
  '["営業", "リーダー", "目標達成"]',
  '{"openness": 55, "conscientiousness": 85, "extraversion": 90, "agreeableness": 50, "neuroticism": 35}',
  '{"goodEvil": 60, "likesDislike": 45, "profitLoss": 85, "interest": 80, "pleasurePain": 35, "difficulty": 25, "possibility": 70, "comfort": 40, "rightWrong": 65}',

  80.00,
  75.00,
  5,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM users WHERE name = '鈴木一郎';
